subject.title: fix(plugins): surface oversized-file warnings in doctor migration reads

question: Should doctor leave oversized legacy plugin state in place for manual recovery, or should it move it into a collision-safe quarantine/archive workflow with a supported recovery path?
rationale: The branch changes persistent-state recovery semantics across three plugins. Code review cannot determine whether intentionally disabling future automatic discovery is acceptable for oversized user state.

options.title: Preserve source and warn
options.body: Leave oversized sources in place, report the size-cap warning, and provide an explicit recovery path; this avoids silently removing data from the migration input.

options.title: Adopt a recoverable quarantine contract
options.body: Move sources only to a unique, non-overwriting quarantine location and add a documented Doctor recovery action that can inspect or retry them.

options.title: Accept archival without recovery
options.body: Keep the current `.migrated` rename behavior and explicitly accept that oversized legacy state will no longer be a doctor migration input.

recommendation.title: Preserve source and warn
recommendation.body: Leave oversized sources in place, report the size-cap warning, and provide an explicit recovery path; this avoids silently removing data from the migration input.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the current archival behavior and is the closest evidence-backed routing candidate in the supplied history.
